# Neon film-reel GIF comparison

[← Back to external website archive](../../README.md#all-cases)

<a href="README.md"><img src="../../../assets/badges/language-en-current.svg" alt="Current language: English" height="34" /></a> <a href="README.zh-CN.md"><img src="../../../assets/badges/language-zh-CN.svg" alt="View translation: 简体中文" height="34" /></a>

**Creator-reported model · Source-only; not independently reproduced**

One comparison case contains both published neon-reel GIF outputs, not two independent prompt cases: 9 distinct frames at 832×832 and 120 ms per frame (1.08 s), and 16 at 512×512 and 80 ms (1.28 s). The source reports high and medium settings respectively; variant is unspecified. The reviewed article does not provide the full original prompt. All frames decode, and source-review playback recorded flashing transparent edge patches. This audit rechecked frames locally, not fresh browser playback.
